headlines.description: — Tomoyuki Sugano picked up his 10th win and Kyle Karros and TJ Rumfield each had two hits as the Colorado Rockies capitalized on a fast start to beat the Milwaukee Brewers 5-2 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tomoyuki Sugano earns his 10th win as Rockies defeat Brewers 5-2

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson hit an RBI single and Seiya Suzuki drew a bases-loaded walk in the 10th inning as the Chicago Cubs held on for a 3-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dansby Swanson's two-out single in the 10th inning, Boyd's strong outing lift Cubs over Pirates 3-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — All-Star Eduardo Rodríguez bounced back from his worst start of the season, Gabriel Moreno drove in the go-ahead run with a sac fly and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Washington Nationals 3-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodríguez, Moreno help the surging Diamondbacks beat the Nationals 3-2

events.name: New York Yankees at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Cam Schlitter bounced back from a poor outing and pitched three-hit ball into the eighth inning, helping the New York Yankees to a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schlitter strikes out 12, Goldschmidt homers as Yankees beat Phillies 1-0

headlines.description: — Matt Olson hit his 27th home run as part of a four-run 10th inning, and the Atlanta Braves defeated the Baltimore Orioles 7-6 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matt Olson's 3-run homer in the 10th inning lifts the Braves past the Orioles 7-6

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Ryan Vilade and Richie Palacios hit home runs, Nick Fortes had four hits, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 11-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays beat the Guardians 11-3 behind homers from Ryan Vilade and Richie Palacios

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Roki Sasaki pitched seven sparkling innings, Kyle Tucker hit a two-run homer and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the New York Mets 4-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roki Sasaki goes 7 innings and Kyle Tucker hits 2-run homer for Dodgers in 4-2 win over Mets

events.name: San Diego Padres at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Luis Rengifo hit a tiebreaking two-run homer in the eighth inning and the San Diego Padres beat Miami 4-2 on Friday night, extending the Marlins’ losing streak to 10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rengifo's two-run HR lifts Padres past skidding Marlins 4-2, extending Miami's losing streak to 10

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Anthony Seigler led off with a homer and had his first four-hit game in the majors, Romy Gonzalez broke an eighth-inning tie with an RBI double and the Boston Red Sox beat the Toronto Blue Jays 6-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seigler has first career 4-hit game to help the Red Sox beat the Blue Jays

events.name: Houston Astros at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Christian Walker hit a three-run double, Cam Smith added a two-run homer in Houston’s eight-run sixth inning and the Astros overcame a five-run deficit to beat the Chicago White Sox 9-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker, Smith spark the Astros' 8-run 6th inning in an 9-5 win over the White Sox

headlines.description: — Jake Burger hit a two-run home run and a go-ahead single to lead the Texas Rangers past the Seattle Mariners 5-4 on Friday night in the opener of a four-game series between the top two teams in the AL West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Burger's homer, 3 RBI, lead Rangers past Mariners 5-4 to open series between AL West leaders

headlines.description: — Jacob Lopez allowed one hit in five innings, Lawrence Butler and Tyler Soderstrom drove in runs and the Athletics beat the Minnesota Twins 2-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lopez allows 1 hit in 5 innings, Butler and Soderstrom drive in runs as A's beat Twins 2-0

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Eugenio Suárez hit a two-run homer, Rhett Lowder pitched two-run ball for five innings and the Cincinnati Reds beat the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eugenio Suárez, Rhett Lowder help power the Reds to a 4-2 victory over the Cardinals

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers homered in his first at-bat and hit a walk-off, two-run single in the 10th inning to give the San Francisco Giants a 7-6 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devers homers early then walks it off in 10th as Giants beat Angels 7-6
